claim_text: Our Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate of 1.87 represents an improvement on the prior year; however, it remains above the levels we expect of ourselves.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: The safety performance table shows Group TRIFR improved from 2.11 in 2024 to 1.87 in 2025.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that the Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate (TRIFR) improved versus the prior year, with a reported TRIFR of 1.87. The provided evidence lists TRIFR values of 2.11 (FY24) and 1.87 (FY25), which substantively supports that TRIFR decreased year-over-year and that 1.87 is the current-year value.
